title: MUSCLE MANGA - Shinogi Kureha's Physique in Grappler Baki
summary: NH profiles Shinogi Kureha, Grappler Baki's 6 ft, 290 lb surgeon-bodybuilder, covering his feats (500 kg hack squats, iron cross with L-sit, decline push-ups), his ego and his defeat by Baki. The point is that muscle and anatomical knowledge without fighting technique don't win fights.
claims: Kureha is depicted at 6 ft and 290 lb with body fat well under 20%
Kureha performs full-ROM hack squats with 500 kg (1,102 lb) for easy reps
Decline push-ups increase range of motion and time under tension, harder still at 300 lb bodyweight
A very large body needs a longer warm-up to get blood flowing through all that muscle, like an F1 car
Being big and muscular doesn't guarantee winning a fight; Kureha throws arm punches and can't transfer bodyweight into blows
At some point size and power become weapons that remove the need for technique against average fighters
exercises: more ROM and time under tension than regular push-ups
